title: Stairway to the Cosmos
description: A man in a dark coat stands on a spiraling metal staircase that ascends through a broken ceiling into a bright sky, surrounded by floating film reels, a clapperboard, a film projector, and an old television set with butterfly wings. The scene is set above dark water with swirling purple clouds and a dramatic, surreal atmosphere.
prompt: A surreal cinematic scene of a man in a long dark coat standing on a twisting metal spiral staircase that rises from dark water into a cracked ceiling framed with blue curtains. Floating around him are vintage film reels, a clapperboard, a film projector casting light, and a television with butterfly wings. Dramatic purple clouds fill the lower sky while bright light breaks through above, in the style of a detailed fantasy painting.
